description: Replay of the authorized read-only queries against the orders database for the pool-exhaustion scenario. The first groups sessions by state so idle-in-transaction growth is visible; the second compares the configured max_connections with the current session count.

queries.sql: SELECT state, count(*) AS sessions FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT current_setting('max_connections') AS max_connections, count(*) AS current_connections FROM pg_stat_activity LIMIT 100
